description: Fullmetrix lets online store owners query their e-commerce analytics in plain language. It reports orders, gross sales, net revenue, taxes, shipping, items sold, and unique, new, and returning customers across all active stores in an organization. Results can be grouped by date, store, country, customer type, or order status over any date range, with per-organization revenue rules applied. Accounts with several organizations can target a specific one.
